uncertainty_cardinality_classes.ONE_OBJECT_UPPER_BOUND: Separately governed evidence establishes one candidate object with maximum incremental contribution of one.
uncertainty_cardinality_classes.UNRESOLVED_CARDINALITY_UNPROVEN: Candidate-like unresolved material exists but retained evidence does not establish a one-product upper bound.
uncertainty_cardinality_classes.UNBOUNDED_SOURCE_OR_ABSTENTION_BARRIER: Source, catalogue, channel, abstention, inaccessible surface, or equivalent barrier lacks a finite latent-product upper bound.
uncertainty_cardinality_classes.TERMINAL: Governed resolved inclusion or exclusion for current accounting.

exhaustive_resolution.admissible_when: Every yield-relevant unresolved candidate cluster in the round has a governed terminal disposition.

worst_case_bound.admissible_when: No cardinality-unproven or unbounded barrier remains and m_r_upper is at or below the frozen threshold.

definitions.C_r: Frozen raw candidate denominator used by the historical stopping rule.
definitions.Y_r: New resolved canonical offering identities in the round.
definitions.U_r_star: Unique ONE_OBJECT_UPPER_BOUND unresolved candidate clusters that could still resolve to a new in-scope offering.

reviewed_statistical.admissible_when: A separate probability-sampling/adjudication design, estimand, uncertainty method, and interpretation rule were preregistered before inspecting the result and yield a one-sided upper bound below the frozen threshold.

scientific_states.SATURATION_IDENTIFIED_UNDER_R1: Historical mechanical saturation and every required tail-round identifiability gate pass.
scientific_states.CONTINUE_RESOLUTION_CENSORED: Historical mechanical saturation may remain immutable, but unresolved cardinality or source barriers prevent scientific low-yield identification.
scientific_states.CONTINUE_MECHANICAL: The historical mechanical stopping rule does not reach saturation.

historical_immutability_rule: Historical PRODUCT_DISCOVERY_RUN and packet bytes remain unchanged. R1 scientific interpretation is a successor record.
temporal_finality_rule: A checkpoint produced before the frozen A2 knowledge-time cutoff may exercise this rule but cannot support final Release-A R1 passage. The rule must be rebound to the final #413 ledger successor after temporal disposition.
boundary: This rule evaluates whether resolved-identity marginal yield is scientifically interpretable under retained resolution uncertainty. It does not allocate canonical identities, establish global completeness, estimate the unseen population, or authorize downstream releases.
